description: This file defines API route handlers for order-related operations in a food delivery backend service using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating carts, fetching orders, modifying cart items, placing orders, listing user orders, and updating order status. The code manages authorization, roles, and order state transitions, and interacts heavily with database models and schemas.

classes.name: OrderOut
classes.description: API schema representing order data sent in responses, including order items and metadata.

methods.name: OrderOut create_cart( payload: CartCreateRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new shopping cart (pending order) for the authenticated customer, associated with a specific restaurant.

methods.name: OrderOut get_order( order_id: UUID, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves an order by ID, ensuring customer access rights.

methods.name: OrderOut upsert_cart_item( order_id: UUID, payload: CartItemUpsertRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Adds or updates an item in an existing pending cart/order.

methods.name: OrderOut remove_cart_item( order_id: UUID, payload: CartItemRemoveRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Removes an item from a pending cart/order by menu item ID.

methods.name: OrderOut place_order( order_id: UUID, payload: PlaceOrderRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Transitions a pending cart into a confirmed order after validation.

methods.name: list[OrderOut] list_orders( status_filter: Optional[OrderStatus] = Query(None, description="Optional status filter."), customer_user_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(None, description="Admin-only: filter by customer user id."), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists orders for the current user, with optional filtering by status and customer ID (admin only).

methods.name: OrderOut update_order_status( order_id: UUID, payload: UpdateOrderStatusRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Updates the status of an order, enforcing role-based transition rules.
